title: Shop Supplies on Customer-Pay Additions — Insurance Claim Repairs Billing Rule
content:
**Rule.** Shop supplies are charged once per Insurance Claim Repairs repair order, with its first customer-pay addition. For an unrelated-damage addition:

- when another customer-pay addition consent on the repair order is already signed, the addition carries **no shop supplies**, because they were charged with the first addition;
- when none is, and **6 percent** of the addition's work amount is more than the supplies cap of **USD 45.00**, the addition carries **USD 45.00**;
- any other addition carries 6 percent of its work amount, rounded to the cent.

The work amount is the labor hours on the consent times the hourly rate, rounded to the cent. "Another customer-pay addition consent" means any customer-pay addition consent on the same repair order already standing signed, whether for an original-equipment part upgrade, unrelated damage or operations the insurer denied.

## Input – judgement – output

| Other customer-pay addition consent already signed on the repair order | 6 percent of the work amount | Shop supplies on this addition |
|---|---|---|
| yes | any | none |
| no | more than USD 45.00 | USD 45.00 |
| no | USD 45.00 or less | 6 percent of the work amount, rounded to the cent |

## Hypothetical work amounts, no other signed consent

| Work amount | 6 percent | Shop supplies |
|---|---|---|
| USD 400.00 | USD 24.00 | USD 24.00 |
| USD 750.00 | USD 45.00 | USD 45.00 (not more than the cap) |
| USD 760.00 | USD 45.60 | USD 45.00 (capped) |
| USD 234.50 | USD 14.07 | USD 14.07 |

With a signed part-upgrade consent already on the repair order, each of these additions would carry no shop supplies.
